items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: But Harry had a lot of the school dates, and Louis' Booking Office was booking bands on all these ships and there was another one there called Rocco's Booking

ctx.x: Was the Gaiety Delicatessen there then, or did that come later? I mean at 46th.

No, I don't remember. All I remember is the Gaiety Theater Building, which was full of these agents and then the poolroom down below. Of course the theater was there, but these agents were something else. There was Louis' Booking Office and above all people, Harry Moss -- Mal Hallett and Harry Moss had a booking office up there. But that was the best one in the building. Of course Harry Moss later went on and he was with MCA and became really a number one booking agent. But Harry had a lot of the school dates,…
Office, and he was selling little bands to all the Catskill Mountains hotels and the summer jobs and things like that. A real crummy setup.
